name: Richie DJ
desc: The DJ software of DJOS: decks, mixer, library and your controller.
use: you play a set, prepare a crate or record your mix.

name: DJOS Preview
desc: Instant track preview: Space plays, the arrows move between tracks, the whole waveform at a glance. Right-click tracks or folders in Dolphin > Preview (DJOS).
use: you go through a folder of new tracks and want to hear each one in a second.

name: Mixxx
desc: Free DJ software. A good backup to have next to Richie DJ.
use: you want a second DJ app as a backup.

name: Ardour
desc: Professional DAW to record, mix and master, with the LV2 / VST3 / CLAP plugins from Fedora.
use: you record several tracks, mix them and master a song or an edit.

name: Bitwig Studio
desc: DAW made for electronic music (paid, with a free demo). The plugin packs below work inside it.
use: you make electronic tracks, remixes or edits (like Ableton Live).

name: REAPER
desc: Light, fast and very complete DAW (60-day trial). The plugin packs below work inside it.
use: you want a light DAW that does everything, on any PC.

name: Ardour (Flathub)
desc: The official Ardour build, if you prefer it to the included one.
use: you need the newest Ardour release.

name: LMMS
desc: Free beat maker: patterns, piano roll and built-in synths.
use: you start making beats (like FL Studio).

name: Hydrogen
desc: Drum machine and pattern sequencer.
use: you program drum patterns.

name: Carla
desc: Plugin host: use any LV2 / VST3 / CLAP plugin on its own or chain them.
use: you want to use a plugin (EQ, reverb, synth) without opening a DAW.

name: MuseScore
desc: Write and play sheet music.
use: you write or read sheet music.

name: Essential effects
desc: EQs, compressors, limiters, reverbs, delays and meters (LSP, x42, Calf, ZAM, Dragonfly, Airwindows, Chow) for Bitwig, REAPER and the other Flathub DAWs. Ardour and Carla use the ones from Fedora.
use: a Flathub DAW (Bitwig, REAPER, LMMS) needs EQs, compressors or reverbs.

name: Synths and samplers
desc: Surge XT, Dexed (DX7), Odin 2, Geonkick (kick drums) and sfizz (sampler) for the Flathub DAWs.
use: you need synths, a kick designer or a sampler in a Flathub DAW.

name: Cardinal
desc: Huge modular synth (VCV Rack based) as a plugin. Big download (~530 MB).
use: you want to patch a modular synth inside your DAW.

name: LosslessCut
desc: Cut, trim, split and join MP3, FLAC, M4A (and video) without re-encoding: the quality stays exactly the same, like mp3DirectCut.
use: you cut the silence at the start of an MP3, split a recorded set into tracks or join parts, without losing quality.

name: Audacity
desc: Record from your sound card or mixer, and cut, fade, normalize and clean up audio (it re-encodes when you export).
use: you record vinyl, a mic or your mixer, or need fades, volume changes or noise removal.

name: Puddletag
desc: Tag editor laid out like a spreadsheet, like Mp3tag: rename files from tags, tags from file names, find and replace, many tracks at once.
use: you clean up the tags of a whole folder the Mp3tag way (file name to tag, tag to file name).

name: Kid3
desc: Edit tags (artist, title, BPM, key, cover) of many tracks at once.
use: you fix the artist, title, BPM, key or cover of a few tracks.

name: MusicBrainz Picard
desc: Finds the right tags and covers for your tracks automatically.
use: your tracks have no tags or wrong ones and you want them filled in by themselves.

name: SoundConverter
desc: Convert many tracks at once (FLAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3…).
use: you need MP3 or AIFF copies of FLAC or WAV tracks (for a USB or another DJ app).

name: Sonic Visualiser
desc: See the spectrum of a track: check if an MP3 is real quality.
use: you want to study a track in depth (spectrum, pitch, tempo).

name: Spek
desc: The quickest way to see a track's spectrum.
use: you check if a 320 kbps MP3 is real or a converted low-quality file.

name: OBS Studio
desc: Stream or record your sets with video, using the graphics card to encode (NVENC on NVIDIA, VA-API on AMD and Intel).
use: you stream a set live or record it with camera or screen.

name: Kdenlive
desc: Edit videos of your sets.
use: you edit the video of a set before posting it.

name: qpwgraph
desc: See and change every audio and MIDI connection.
use: you route audio between apps, or see where a sound goes.

name: Haruna
desc: Video and audio player.
use: you watch a video or play any media file.

name: EasyEffects
desc: EQ and effects for the desktop sound (headphones, browser). Not for your sets.
use: you want an EQ for your headphones or the browser (never for a set).

name: Flatseal
desc: Give Flathub apps access to more folders (for example a music disk).
use: a Flathub app can't see your music disk.
